description: This file defines the EraserTrail class for handling eraser interactions in a drawing application, including erasing elements based on eraser path and shape intersection logic.

classes.name: EraserTrail
classes.description: A class extending AnimatedTrail to implement eraser functionality, tracking elements to erase based on user input.

methods.name: startPath
methods.description: Initializes a new eraser path at given coordinates.

methods.name: addPointToPath
methods.description: Adds a point to the eraser path and updates elements to be erased.

methods.name: updateElementsToBeErased
methods.description: Determines which elements intersect with the eraser path and should be erased.

methods.name: endPath
methods.description: Finalizes the eraser path, clearing internal states.
